label: D1 only: big after a1->S1 unrewarded, low after any S2 visit
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 u") ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 0) * (prev_state == -1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == -1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 0) * (prev_state == -1)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (zero at GO/D2). Magnitude is set mainly by the previous trial: about +2.0 above baseline after a1 -> S1 (common) unrewarded, +0.37 after a1 S1 rewarded, and about -0.4 after any trial that reached S2 (all four S2 patterns are alike). After a2 -> S1 (rare) unrewarded it is near baseline on its own but about +0.5 higher when the trial before was also unrewarded (it stays high through streaks of unrewarded trials). On the window first trial (previous trial unknown) it goes up with the ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good. Belief on its own adds almost nothing once the last trial is known (D1*belief_lo weight about 0.03). Only observed inputs, no future variables. Dev R^2 beyond timing 0.55, test 0.56; last-trial table alone 0.53; observed-cue ceiling 0.63, all-cue ceiling 0.75. Compared with the earlier model-policy explanation, the observed-only version loses mainly the graded policy part (policy decile alone 0.24). Unexplained: some sustained high firing in unrewarded streaks and at window starts.
